decisionProvenance.sourceWording: Продолжи работу. Все где нужно принимать решения типа РАЗРЕШАЮ делай сама или поручи отдельному агенту. Важно, чтобы процесс не останавливался из-за этого
decisionProvenance.interpretation: Project owner standing delegation to the AI coordinator for ordinary reversible project/product decisions so workflow does not stop.

unencryptedTransferWarning.ru: Dora передаст выбранные данные разговора как незашифрованный текст или файл. После копирования, сохранения или отправки Dora не управляет копией в буфере обмена, другом приложении или выбранном хранилище.
unencryptedTransferWarning.en: Dora will transfer the selected conversation data as unencrypted text or files. After copying, saving, or sharing, Dora does not control copies held by the clipboard, another app, or the selected storage provider.

contentFreeRecoveryContext.conservativeDeadlineRule: earliest valid value among recovered effectiveExpiresAt, recovered createdAt plus one hour, and firstObservedAt plus one hour; if no earlier trustworthy value exists use firstObservedAt plus one hour

transitions.guard: no active export session
transitions.action: create a fresh attempt; clear selections, acknowledgements and pendingOutcome

transitions.guard: valid recovery context has destinationClass=SHARESHEET, pendingOutcome=COMPLETED and deleteNowConfirmedAfterWarning=true
transitions.action: restore context; retain pendingOutcome; set cleanupReason=DELETE_NOW_CONFIRMED; request temp cleanup

transitions.guard: valid recovery context has destinationClass=SHARESHEET, pendingOutcome=COMPLETED, deleteNowConfirmedAfterWarning=false and safeReleaseObserved=true
transitions.action: restore context; retain pendingOutcome; set cleanupReason=SAFE_RELEASE_OBSERVED; request temp cleanup

transitions.guard: valid recovery context has destinationClass=SHARESHEET, pendingOutcome=COMPLETED, deleteNowConfirmedAfterWarning=false, safeReleaseObserved=false and now>=effectiveExpiresAt
transitions.action: restore context; retain pendingOutcome; set cleanupReason=EXPIRED; request temp cleanup

transitions.guard: valid recovery context has destinationClass=SHARESHEET, pendingOutcome=COMPLETED, deleteNowConfirmedAfterWarning=false, safeReleaseObserved=false and now<effectiveExpiresAt
transitions.action: restore content-free recovery context and Recent exports entry; retain temp; expose warned Delete now; claim no delivery

transitions.guard: valid recovery context has destinationClass=SAF, pendingOutcome=COMPLETED and finalDestinationCloseObserved=true
transitions.action: restore context; retain pendingOutcome; set cleanupReason=SAF_CLOSE_OBSERVED; request staging cleanup

transitions.guard: valid recovery context has pendingOutcome fixed as one member of {FAILED_RETRYABLE, CANCELLED}
transitions.action: restore context; retain pendingOutcome; set cleanupReason=NO_EXTERNAL_ACCESS_WINDOW; request temp cleanup

transitions.guard: recoveryContextStatus=INVALID and now<conservativeRetentionDeadline
transitions.action: reconstruct content-free context with destinationClass=SHARESHEET_CONSERVATIVE, pendingOutcome=CANCELLED and handoffEvidence=UNKNOWN; retain temp; expose warned Delete now; claim neither success nor delivery

transitions.guard: recoveryContextStatus=INVALID and now>=conservativeRetentionDeadline
transitions.action: reconstruct content-free context with pendingOutcome=CANCELLED; set cleanupReason=CONSERVATIVE_RETENTION_EXPIRED; request temp cleanup
